Lars Moravy on joining Tesla ⚡

“Back in 2009, I was at Honda—stable job, good life—but it felt uninspiring. I saw a ten-year roadmap of small engine improvements and realized this wasn’t the future.

Then I heard about Tesla’s Roadster project. It felt fast, real, and ambitious. A friend connected me with a recruiter, and after one call I started seriously thinking about it.

I’ve always loved cars and wanted to build something meaningful. Tesla gave me both. My wife was willing to move to California, so we said, let’s try it for a year.

That was 16 years ago… and I’m still here.”
